newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka closes weaker on dollar demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka closes weaker on dollar demand.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka ended weaker at 42.5400/5450 to the dollar in interbank trading against a previous close of 42.5350/5400, dealers said.
They said demand for dollars rose after some banks settled claims at the central bank clearing accounts.
The Taka was quoted at 42.5390/5450 per dollar in early trade but most deals were done at the 42.5420/30 level.
Interbank call money rates finished flat at 5.0 percent to 5.5 percent. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
